title: 九州新幹線
summary: 以九州新幹線分期連接的歷史為背景，建立坡道、橋梁與城市車站交替的教學路線。學徒要比較爬坡功率和下坡制動的能量流向，並在地震、短時暴雨與設備停機時安排可驗證的降級營運。
summaryEn: Use the staged connection of the Kyushu Shinkansen to construct a teaching route alternating gradients, bridges and urban stops. Compare energy flow during climbing and downhill braking. Define verifiable degraded operation under an earthquake warning, short intense rainfall and equipment downtime, rather than treating rated traction power as evidence that every disrupted movement remains feasible.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率與黏著限制與可用牽引力
stages.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power & Adhesion limit and usable traction
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」與「黏著限制與可用牽引力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Gradient resistance and climbing power" and "Adhesion limit and usable traction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」如何影響九州新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gradient resistance and climbing power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kyushu Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。功率還與速度相乘，因此相同牽引力下高速爬坡更耗功率；下坡則需處理持續制動能量而非僅一次停車。 坡度以升高量除以水平距離表示，百分比與小數不可混用。此項只表示重力位能增加的速率，總牽引功率還要加上加速、滾動、氣動及轉換損失。 在同一坡道比較滿載與輕載的重力功率需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Climbing raises gravitational potential energy. For small gradients, the along-track gravity force is approximately weight times gradient. Multiplication by speed gives power, making faster climbing more demanding at equal force; descending requires continuous energy management rather than merely one stopping event. Gradient is rise divided by horizontal distance, so percentage and decimal representations must not be mixed. This term only gives the rate of gravitational potential-energy increase. Total traction demand also includes acceleration, rolling resistance, aerodynamics and conversion losses. Compare gravitational power demand for loaded and lightly loaded trains on one gradient. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gradient resistance and climbing power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s；計算：climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s; calculation: climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gradient resistance and climbing power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率
knowledge.text: 列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。功率還與速度相乘，因此相同牽引力下高速爬坡更耗功率；下坡則需處理持續制動能量而非僅一次停車。
knowledge.textEn: Climbing raises gravitational potential energy. For small gradients, the along-track gravity force is approximately weight times gradient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gradient resistance and climbing power" is correct?
options: 長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動
列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。
電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著
optionsEn: One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent.
Climbing raises gravitational potential energy.
A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion.
quiz.explanation: 列車爬坡需提高重力位能，坡度小時沿線重力分量約等於重量乘坡度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Climbing raises gravitational potential energy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gradient resistance and climbing power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s；計算：climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 333300 kg，其餘固定，結果為 2615.738 kW。模型邊界：小坡度且定速；不含空阻、輪阻、加速與傳動損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s; calculation: climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 333300 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 2615.738 kW. Model boundary: Small gradient and constant speed; aerodynamic drag, rolling resistance, acceleration and drive losses are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s；計算：climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 333300 kg，其餘固定，結果為 2615.738 kW。模型邊界：小坡度且定速；不含空阻、輪阻、加速與傳動損失。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s; calculation: climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 333300 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 2615.738 kW. Model boundary: Small gradient and constant speed; aerodynamic drag, rolling resistance, acceleration and drive losses are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gradient resistance and climbing power", which statement holds?
options: 煞車盤平均溫度低就能保證局部沒有熱點
地震預警成功觸發就代表列車必能在強震前完全停下
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s。
optionsEn: A low mean brake-disc temperature guarantees the absence of local hot spots.
A successfully triggered earthquake warning guarantees a complete stop before strong shaking.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s；計算：climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=303000 kg; gradient=0.02 1; v=40 m/s; calculation: climbing=mass*9.81*gradient*v/1000=2377.944 kW. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gradient resistance and climbing power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。 由高程剖面核對坡度，使用同一時間窗比對速度與牽引功率，另列非重力負載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent. Check gradient from the elevation profile, compare speed and traction power over one time window, and list non-gravitational loads separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用相同高差設計長緩坡與短陡坡，對比理想位能和峰值功率，指出兩者為何不能用同一項設備額定值評估。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 climbing，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design a long gentle and short steep climb with equal height gain, compare ideal energy and peak power, and explain why one equipment rating cannot evaluate both. Also recalculate climbing for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating; a gradient-sign error can mislabel an energy-consuming section as regenerative. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。 由高程剖面核對坡度，使用同一時間窗比對速度與牽引功率，另列非重力負載。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent. Check gradient from the elevation profile, compare speed and traction power over one time window, and list non-gravitational loads separately.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用相同高差設計長緩坡與短陡坡，對比理想位能和峰值功率，指出兩者為何不能用同一項設備額定值評估。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 climbing，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Design a long gentle and short steep climb with equal height gain, compare ideal energy and peak power, and explain why one equipment rating cannot evaluate both. Also recalculate climbing for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gradient resistance and climbing power"?
options: 以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
optionsEn: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
quiz.explanation: 以路線縱斷面和列車速度重建位能變化，對照受電功率積分；坡度資料與里程基準必須一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct potential-energy change from the vertical alignment and train speed, compare it with integrated line power, and keep gradient and distance datums consistent. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 坡度阻力與爬坡功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gradient resistance and climbing power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gradient resistance and climbing power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。 功率不足時須分辨坡度阻力與黏著限制，不能只加大電流。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating; a gradient-sign error can mislabel an energy-consuming section as regenerative. When power is insufficient, distinguish gradient resistance from adhesion limits rather than only increasing current. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在同一坡道比較滿載與輕載的重力功率需求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare gravitational power demand for loaded and lightly loaded trains on one gradient.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「長下坡只需通過一次緊急停車試驗就能驗證持續制動」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One emergency stop test verifies continuous braking capability on a long descent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。 功率不足時須分辨坡度阻力與黏著限制，不能只加大電流。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating; a gradient-sign error can mislabel an energy-consuming section as regenerative. When power is insufficient, distinguish gradient resistance from adhesion limits rather than only increasing current.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「坡度阻力與爬坡功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gradient resistance and climbing power" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。
電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating.
A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion.
quiz.explanation: 忽略長下坡持續熱負荷會把短時煞車能力誤當連續能力；坡度正負號錯誤則會把耗能段當成回收段。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring sustained downhill heat confuses short-term braking capability with continuous rating; a gradient-sign error can mislabel an energy-consuming section as regenerative. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Adhesion limit and usable traction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「黏著限制與可用牽引力」如何影響九州新幹線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Adhesion limit and usable traction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kyushu Shinkansen”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 牽引力需要透過接觸斑傳到軌道，簡化上限與黏著係數及動輪法向力相乘。電機能提供更大扭矩不代表輪軌能傳遞；雨水、落葉與速度都會改變接觸狀態，使固定係數模型失去精度。 法向荷重應只取實際驅動接觸點的總量，不能自動使用整列重量。此上限也不描述黏著峰後的滑移控制；若輪重轉移，就要以每個接觸點重新分配。 檢查坡道起步時動輪荷重和接觸狀態能否傳遞要求牽引力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「黏著限制與可用牽引力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Traction reaches the track through contact patches. A simple upper bound multiplies adhesion coefficient by normal force on driven wheels. More motor torque does not guarantee more transmitted force; rain, leaves and speed alter contact conditions and limit the accuracy of a fixed coefficient. Normal load must include only the driven contacts, not automatically the weight of the whole train. This bound does not describe slip control beyond the adhesion peak. Wheel-load transfer requires a new allocation across individual contact points. Check whether driven-wheel load and contact condition can transmit the requested force during a gradient start. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Adhesion limit and usable traction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N；計算：traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N; calculation: traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「黏著限制與可用牽引力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Adhesion limit and usable traction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Traction reaches the track through contact patches. A simple upper bound multiplies adhesion coefficient by normal force on driven wheels.

knowledge.text: 誤解：電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

options: 電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著

牽引力需要透過接觸斑傳到軌道，簡化上限與黏著係數及動輪法向力相乘。
optionsEn: A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion.
Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
Traction reaches the track through contact patches.
quiz.explanation: 牽引力需要透過接觸斑傳到軌道，簡化上限與黏著係數及動輪法向力相乘。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Traction reaches the track through contact patches. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Adhesion limit and usable traction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「黏著限制與可用牽引力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Adhesion limit and usable traction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N；計算：traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN。敏感度：mu 單獨增加百分之十至 0.19998 1，其餘固定，結果為 179.982 kN。模型邊界：準靜態庫倫上限與均勻輪重；未建模蠕滑曲線及動態減載。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N; calculation: traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN. Sensitivity: mu, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.19998 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 179.982 kN. Model boundary: Quasi-static Coulomb bound with uniform wheel load; creep curves and dynamic unloading are not modelled. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較輪速、列車獨立速度與牽引電流，找出滑轉開始點；濕乾條件必須分組，不能用全日平均係數掩蓋低黏著尾端。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare wheel speed, independently measured train speed and traction current to locate slip onset, separating wet and dry conditions rather than hiding low-adhesion tails in a daily mean.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N；計算：traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN。敏感度：mu 單獨增加百分之十至 0.19998 1，其餘固定，結果為 179.982 kN。模型邊界：準靜態庫倫上限與均勻輪重；未建模蠕滑曲線及動態減載。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N; calculation: traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN. Sensitivity: mu, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.19998 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 179.982 kN. Model boundary: Quasi-static Coulomb bound with uniform wheel load; creep curves and dynamic unloading are not modelled.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「黏著限制與可用牽引力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Adhesion limit and usable traction", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N。
任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度
橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成

Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed.
Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N；計算：traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mu=0.1818 1; weight=900000 N; calculation: traction=mu*weight/1000=163.62 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Adhesion limit and usable traction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「黏著限制與可用牽引力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Adhesion limit and usable traction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較輪速、列車獨立速度與牽引電流，找出滑轉開始點；濕乾條件必須分組，不能用全日平均係數掩蓋低黏著尾端。 以獨立地速校對輪周速度，核實輪徑設定，再按乾濕條件與軸荷分類比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare wheel speed, independently measured train speed and traction current to locate slip onset, separating wet and dry conditions rather than hiding low-adhesion tails in a daily mean. Calibrate wheel-periphery speed against independent ground speed, verify wheel-diameter settings, and compare results by wetness condition and axle load. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把黏著係數減半並比較動輪荷重調整，計算牽引上限，解釋為何撒砂或控制策略的效果需用試驗而不能只看馬達功率。 再以本單元 mu 的對照值重算 traction，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve adhesion and compare a change in driven-wheel load, calculate traction bounds, and explain why sanding or control performance requires tests rather than motor-power data alone. Also recalculate traction for the alternative mu value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只提高扭矩可能觸發滑轉並降低可控牽引；輪徑設定誤差也會製造假的滑差，需以獨立地速判別。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Increasing torque can trigger slip and reduce controllable traction; an incorrect wheel diameter also creates apparent slip, requiring independent ground-speed evidence. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較輪速、列車獨立速度與牽引電流，找出滑轉開始點；濕乾條件必須分組，不能用全日平均係數掩蓋低黏著尾端。 以獨立地速校對輪周速度，核實輪徑設定，再按乾濕條件與軸荷分類比對。
knowledge.textEn: Compare wheel speed, independently measured train speed and traction current to locate slip onset, separating wet and dry conditions rather than hiding low-adhesion tails in a daily mean. Calibrate wheel-periphery speed against independent ground speed, verify wheel-diameter settings, and compare results by wetness condition and axle load.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把黏著係數減半並比較動輪荷重調整，計算牽引上限，解釋為何撒砂或控制策略的效果需用試驗而不能只看馬達功率。 再以本單元 mu 的對照值重算 traction，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Halve adhesion and compare a change in driven-wheel load, calculate traction bounds, and explain why sanding or control performance requires tests rather than motor-power data alone. Also recalculate traction for the alternative mu value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「黏著限制與可用牽引力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Adhesion limit and usable traction"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較輪速、列車獨立速度與牽引電流，找出滑轉開始點；濕乾條件必須分組，不能用全日平均係數掩蓋低黏著尾端。
量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Compare wheel speed, independently measured train speed and traction current to locate slip onset, separating wet and dry conditions rather than hiding low-adhesion tails in a daily mean.
Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.
quiz.explanation: 比較輪速、列車獨立速度與牽引電流，找出滑轉開始點；濕乾條件必須分組，不能用全日平均係數掩蓋低黏著尾端。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare wheel speed, independently measured train speed and traction current to locate slip onset, separating wet and dry conditions rather than hiding low-adhesion tails in a daily mean. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 黏著限制與可用牽引力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Adhesion limit and usable traction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「黏著限制與可用牽引力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Adhesion limit and usable traction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只提高扭矩可能觸發滑轉並降低可控牽引；輪徑設定誤差也會製造假的滑差，需以獨立地速判別。 先查輪徑與地速誤差，避免把量測偏差當成真滑轉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Increasing torque can trigger slip and reduce controllable traction; an incorrect wheel diameter also creates apparent slip, requiring independent ground-speed evidence. Check diameter and ground-speed errors before interpreting measurement bias as actual wheel slip. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：檢查坡道起步時動輪荷重和接觸狀態能否傳遞要求牽引力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Check whether driven-wheel load and contact condition can transmit the requested force during a gradient start.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「電機額定扭矩夠大就不需要考慮輪軌黏著」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sufficiently large rated motor torque eliminates the need to consider wheel-rail adhesion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只提高扭矩可能觸發滑轉並降低可控牽引；輪徑設定誤差也會製造假的滑差，需以獨立地速判別。 先查輪徑與地速誤差，避免把量測偏差當成真滑轉。
knowledge.textEn: Increasing torque can trigger slip and reduce controllable traction; an incorrect wheel diameter also creates apparent slip, requiring independent ground-speed evidence. Check diameter and ground-speed errors before interpreting measurement bias as actual wheel slip.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「黏著限制與可用牽引力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Adhesion limit and usable traction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網
只提高扭矩可能觸發滑轉並降低可控牽引；輪徑設定誤差也會製造假的滑差，需以獨立地速判別。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
Increasing torque can trigger slip and reduce controllable traction.
quiz.explanation: 只提高扭矩可能觸發滑轉並降低可控牽引；輪徑設定誤差也會製造假的滑差，需以獨立地速判別。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Increasing torque can trigger slip and reduce controllable traction; an incorrect wheel diameter also creates apparent slip, requiring independent ground-speed evidence. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
